I've been playing MH4U for a bit but there are still some things I don't understand. Hopefully someone can answer these questions for me.

  1. Sometimes when I hit a monster I get a yellow flash instead of (or with) the blood splatter effect. What does this mean?

  2. How do Paralysis and Poison work on monsters? Do I just keep hitting them with my weapon until some threshold is reached at which point the status is applied?

  3. Do weapons with elemental damage immediately deal that elemental damage or does it have to build up to a certain level at which point elemental burst damage is applied?

  4. What does weapon affinity do?

  5. Is there any way in-game to determine what a monster's weaknesses are? If I hit a monster with fire damage and it is weak/strong against it will there be any indication? Does the beastiary update with relevant information?

On a side note, it seems this game really enjoys withholding information just to make its systems esoteric.
Any Monster Hunter players out there? I have some questions.

What does weapon affinity do?

Affinity increases or decreases the chance to do a crit.

1. Sounds like you're inflicting a type of status, been awhile since I've played but if I had to guess I'd imagine it's either paralysis or KO

  2. How it works is that every monster begins with a starting threshold, every time you attack your weapon can do the status damage, if it does then you'll see the special effect along with the blood effect, if I recall it's only about 1/10th of the number the weapon says per hit, but might be wrong on that. Eventually when you pass the threshold, the effect will happen and different monsters will recover sooner than others. After the status has passed their threshold will increase though, while there is a maximum to it, just keep in mind that every time you inflict the status it's likely going to be harder to inflict it again. Another thing if they spend I believe 10 seconds without getting anymore 'status damage' of that type (or maybe just any damage) they will start to recover from the status damage you've applied, so if say their threshold is 400 and you inflict 399 damage, then walk away and do nothing for an hour, expect to be starting from 0.

  3. The damage will only be applied I believe about once in every three hits, you'll see a special effect when it's applied such as some extra ice or lightning depending on the element, just like everything else (including attack) it's less than what the number on the weapon says but it's still a fair indication. Do be aware that not only are different monsters resistant/weak to different elements, but different parts of their body are weak/resistant to elements, for the most part though most enemies only take about 10-50% damage from the element, you can look up their stats (I'll provide a link to a good database at the end of all this below) of elemental damage so unless you're looking at say S&S or Dual-swords or some other weapon that has VERY high status/elemental damage don't worry about it too much.

  4. Affinity is your chance to do a critical hit, there are also negative criticals so negative affinity can have bad effects.

  5. I'm not sure about the bestiary because I never use them, I instead use a much better online database, I'll give more information below.

Since you seem rather new to the series I'll give you some links, first to some EXCELLENT tutorials that helped teach me a lot more in-depth about the game when I was first getting used to it and second to a database that you would be well served to use for getting information on monsters and checking out armor sets. It's not so great on quest information or items, but it's very useful.

Tutorials (don't overwhelm yourself by trying to watch them all immediately, just start with videos on anything you're curious about): https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDR3ta7VqKryhsa6RoWFkHNaNByRcgd3Y for tips and https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDR3ta7VqKrwAHPSAudDagumWffFyHK6g for weapons

Database: http://kiranico.com/en/mh4u#! just try using the search for any monsters, and the armor builder if you want to try to find some good armor sets. While a lot of people make use of "Athena's ASS" for help with armor stuff, I personally never got into it, still figured I should mention if you want to try looking it up.

Hope that was all rather easy to understand, I'm rather tired and it's been awhile since I've played so I'm a bit foggy on some of the mechanics.

No problem, though I might advise checking out some of those videos if/when you get a chance if you haven't, I rewatched a couple and turns out that some of my info was wrong. You'll do status damage on every 3rd hit, but elemental damage should be every hit, plus it was thanks to those videos that I learned about motion values (basically attacks that take longer do more damage, it's a kind of multiplier, so quick attacks might be safer but are weaker)

Regarding 5. If you have at least one armor piece unlocked for a particular monster (any rank will do), have a look at it and see what it's elemental resistances are. You can get a bit of an idea of what element they're weakest against. Keep in mind that for some monsters elemental weaknesses are best used on specific parts of a monster.

Best best though is to have a look at a wikia site. There's also apps you can download for your phone for quick access to monster strengths/weaknesses. I use MH4U Database for Android. Has all the monster info you need. But last I used it, it didn't have every single DLC quest listed.
